verifications.summary: All 10 config keys verified against spec: schema definitions, type coercion, validation rules, priority cascade, and error handling are correctly implemented.

schema_completeness.detail: All 10 keys (host, port, log_level, request_timeout, max_connections, debug_mode, static_dir, cors_origins, keep_alive_timeout, ssl_enabled) present with correct type, default, env_var, and validation spec.

api_contract.detail: ConfigValidationError(ValueError), load_config(), get_schema(), validate_value() all match spec signatures.

type_coercion.detail: int: parses strings, rejects floats. bool: accepts true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off (case-insensitive). enum: case-sensitive match. string: as-is. All raise ConfigValidationError on failure.

validation_rules.detail: port [2048,49151], request_timeout [1,3600], max_connections [1,1000], keep_alive_timeout [1,300] all inclusive ranges. host/static_dir non-empty. log_level exact match. cors_origins unrestricted.

priority_cascade.detail: CLI > env > file > defaults. Merge order in load_config correctly implements this.

error_handling.detail: ConfigValidationError raised for all validation failures with key name in message. FileNotFoundError for missing config file.

edge_cases.detail: Unknown config file keys ignored. Unknown CLI keys ignored. All keys always present in output (defaults baseline). Empty string in lower-priority source overridden by higher priority.

notes.detail: validate_value for non_empty_string returns message 'value must be a non-empty string' without including the actual invalid value in the message. Spec requires 'the error must include the key name and the invalid value'. The key name is present but the value is omitted. Impact is negligible since the invalid value is always an empty string in this context.
